plan: Implement the timeline canvas panel: TimelineEvent nodes positioned by narrativeOrder horizontally and parallelGroup swimlanes vertically, with cause->consequence edges derived from consequenceIds arrays, drag-to-connect, context menu, event editor drawer, keyboard shortcuts, CanvasLayout persistence (panelKey='timeline-canvas'). Also fix useCanvasPanel saved-position restoration bug and extend layoutStrategy to accept custom function for domain-specific positioning.
actions: Fixed useCanvasPanel.ts: saved node positions from CanvasLayout were never restored on reload. Added savedLayoutRef to store loaded layout nodes, modified items effect to check saved positions for nodes not yet in state. Ensures positions persist across page reloads.
Extended useCanvasPanel layoutStrategy type to accept custom function (index, total, item) => Position, in addition to 'grid' | 'circle'. Enables domain-specific positioning logic per panel.

Created TimelineNodeContent.tsx: pure presentational component for timeline event node body inside CanvasNodeShell. Shows order badge (narrativeOrder+1 zero-padded), storyDate, title, description (3-line clamp), duration with ClockCircleOutlined, parallelGroup tag. Includes data-timeline-node attribute for edge drop targeting.

Created TimelineCanvasPanel.tsx: full panel with timeline layout function (horizontal by narrativeOrder*320, vertical by parallelGroup swimlane via useMemo group-to-lane mapping). Derives edges from consequenceIds arrays on TimelineEvent records — edge ID format ${fromId}->${toId}, label '导致', kind 'consequence'. Connection drag creates cause->consequence by updating both events' consequenceIds/causeIds arrays in a transaction. Delete event cleans up references in related events' arrays. Delete edge removes from both events' arrays. Event editor Drawer: title, storyDate, duration, parallelGroup, description, participantIds multi-select. Context menu, keyboard shortcuts, minimap, zoom controls, container size tracking via ResizeObserver.

Created TimelineCanvasPanel.test.tsx: 9 SSR tests using renderToStaticMarkup with ConfigProvider(darkAlgorithm) + App wrapper. Mocks dexie-react-hooks useLiveQuery and db module (timelineEvents table with where().equals().sortBy() chain). 6 tests for TimelineNodeContent (title/storyDate/description, order badge '03', duration '半天', parallelGroup '主线', empty description fallback '尚未描述', data-timeline-node attribute). 3 tests for TimelineCanvasPanel (header '故事时间线'/'TIMELINE CANVAS'/'添加事件', empty state '还没有事件'/'创建第一个事件', undo/redo buttons).

Wired TimelineCanvasPanel into NovelStudio.tsx: added lazy import, modified LibraryWorkspace ternary to add timeline case (mode === 'timeline'). Removed StoryEntity unused import from TimelineCanvasPanel.
Fixed two editing errors in NovelStudio.tsx: '?:' typo (should be '?') and missing '}' before in JSX expression.
Ran vitest: 15 test files, 118 tests passed (9 new timeline + 109 existing). Ran tsc --noEmit: exit 0, no errors.

selfReflection: Loop 5 implemented the timeline canvas panel with two notable design decisions. First, timeline edges are embedded in event data (causeIds/consequenceIds arrays) rather than stored as separate records like character relations — so edges are derived/computed from consequenceIds on each render, and connection creation/deletion updates both events' arrays in a transaction. Edge IDs use format ${fromId}->${toId} for easy parsing during deletion. Second, the existing useCanvasPanel layoutStrategy ('grid'|'circle') didn't support timeline semantics (horizontal by narrativeOrder, vertical by parallelGroup), so I extended the type to accept a custom function (index, total, item) => Position. This pattern will also benefit the worldview panel (cluster-by-kind layout). Also discovered and fixed a critical bug: saved node positions from CanvasLayout were never restored on reload because the load effect only set the viewport. Fixed by adding savedLayoutRef to store loaded layout nodes, and modifying the items effect to check saved positions. This fix benefits all panels (character, timeline, and future worldview/planning).

selfAssessment.reason: Timeline canvas panel is fully implemented and verified with 9 passing tests. The custom layoutStrategy extension and saved-position restoration fix improve the reusable useCanvasPanel hook for future panels. No blockers for worldview or planning canvas panels.
